name: tests-half-alt-napalm-canonical-bgp-configuration-diagnostics
instr:
Add portable BGP diagnostic snapshots, semantic comparison, compliance reporting and mock replay.

Snapshot dictionaries round-trip with exactly schema_version, driver, configuration, observations and warnings; schema version is 1 and unsupported versions raise BGPDiagnosticsError. Retain ordinary configuration, typed observations/warnings, canonical observation order and distinct native outcomes. Empty snapshots encode configuration {}, observations [] and warnings []. Plain snapshots reconstruct after session close. Missing, empty, malformed and conversion warnings remain distinct; warnings retain valid sibling values and supplied canonical paths, including separate IPv6 teardown threshold/timeout values.

Compare observations by semantic path, ignoring driver/native-path differences for equal values. Report added/removed/changed values and warning differences, preserving before/after and associated warnings. Order differences by path then kind independently of input order. Equal snapshots return (). Differences round-trip through dictionaries. Protected observations and differences serialize without source authentication secrets while indicating protected participation and changes.

IOS empty configuration produces empty configuration and () observations/warnings. IOS and Junos authentication yields protected observations and secret-free serialization. IOS-XR keeps IPv6 teardown threshold/timeout at distinct paths. EOS group filtering excludes other groups from the snapsho
